premises: Equimolar CoCrFeNiTi in as-cast state is a single-phase disordered solid solution with low hardness/strength and high plasticity.
Nanoscale precipitates or local chemical ordering act as effective dislocation-pinning obstacles.
Heat treatment at ~650–700 °C can induce nanoscale precipitates (e.g., B2) in this alloy.
Precipitation strengthening increases yield strength and hardness at the cost of ductility.
